svg.title: Two accessible Cedar layout options
svg.desc: Original concept plans. Left: one 40-foot container with a full-width bathroom, open living and kitchen, and a single bedroom with a 1.5 metre transfer side. Right: two 40-foot containers side by side, giving a double bedroom, accessible bathroom, wider living and a work nook. Both show 0.9 metre door openings, step-free porch routes and a 1.5 metre turning circle. These are layout studies, not certified accessible or construction drawings.

g.text: One-person accessible layout · single bed · 1.5 m turning
0.9 m door · step-free porch · lowered work surface
A double bed with 1.5 m transfer space does not fit across 2.35 m clear width.
One-bedroom accessible layout · 5 m combined width
0.9 m doors · roll-in shower · step-free porch · clear turning
Requires a structural opening/transfer frame between the two shells.
Step-free approach · 1.5 m turning in kitchen/living · 0.9 m door leaves · reachable storage · no threshold at the porch
A firm, drained, snow-cleared route to the parking/drop-off · accessible emergency egress · a place to wait for help
What is not resolved by a drawing
Structural opening and reinforcement · fire separation/egress · foundation and drainage · door hardware/operable windows ·
kitchen/bath fixture clearances · winter maintenance · personal care · CSA B651/code review · consultant sign-off
Concept layout study · not certified accessible · not construction drawings · Containers Hamlet · CC BY-SA 4.0
